digest.component_or_area: Entire rebar repository - comprehensive quality assessment
propositions: 87 source modules exceed the documented 500-LOC target; llm/runner.py, _config_schema.py, and _commands/init.py are 800 LOC each, and compute() in next_batch.py and import_tickets() in import_ndjson.py combine multiple responsibilities into single functions with complexity above 15.

Mypy passes globally, but a diagnostic --disallow-untyped-defs run found 687 errors; only rebar.graph and rebar.grounding enforce untyped definitions, and ignore_missing_imports is set globally instead of at transport boundaries.
Architectural enforcement is selective via bespoke high-risk seam checks rather than systemic repository-wide DAG contracts, creating dependency management risk outside protected families.
Documentation examples contradict reconciler behavior: README.md:44 and user-guide.md:115 teach --assignee alice, while config.md:431 requires email/accountId, leaving bare handles unassigned.

Tests exhibit repeated flakiness in test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted with xdist worker death ('node down: Not properly terminated') across multiple Gerrit runs, blocking the default-suite gate with 8–24 minutes rerun latency per occurrence.
